polyphonyLimitMeaning: 0 = intentionally unspecified until a real board profile is modeled
notes: This generic profile does not claim to emulate a specific historical daughterboard.
SoundFont selection is host/chassis configuration and becomes active on power cycle.
Guest MIDI still must reach the future daughterboard through the emulated sound-card MIDI path.
defaultBankPolicy: If SB16.sf2 is absent, host chooses the smallest .sf2 in <project-root>/Banks; an explicitly selected nondefault bank does not fall back.
